judged_text: findMembers returns undefined (bare return) when the group name is empty, whereas the previous implementation returned Ember.RSVP.resolve([]), breaking any caller that chains .then on the result. The group-members route's previous afterModel chained on findMembers' promise; any remaining caller that does group.findMembers().then(...) (the pattern the deleted route code used) throws a TypeError on new/unsaved groups, and the empty case no longer produces the empty member list the old contract promised.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js`, `findMembers` now does a bare `return` when `name` is empty (`if (Em.isEmpty(this.get('name'))) { return ; }`), whereas it previously returned `Ember.RSVP.resolve([])`. This makes the method’s return type inconsistent (sometimes `undefined` instead of a promise) and also stops it from producing/setting an empty member list in that case, which can break any caller that expects to chain `.then(...)` or relies on the empty-list behavior.
